I answered nine of the ten questions. Question 10 can't be answered because Quillon Aerospace isn't in the store. All reads were pinned to position 32371, so every answer comes from the same snapshot of the store.

**1. Kestral Farms:** 5 orders, coming to **92,404.14** altogether. No customer is spelled "Kestral". The only close match is **Kestrel Farms** (C-687, Ireland), and I've assumed that's who you meant.
- O-11604 (open) 7,051.59; O-11763 (open) 26,628.03; O-12702 (shipped) 27,453.20; O-13314 (cancelled) 27,760.12; O-14550 (shipped) 3,511.20.
- By status: open 2 orders (33,679.62), shipped 2 (30,964.40), cancelled 1 (27,760.12).
- No retired orders are hidden from the count.

**2. Torino Guarnizoni:** the store spells it **Torino Guarnizioni** (S-109). It makes its goods in **Italy (IT)**; its notes say it ships from Bologna by truck. **7** of our products are theirs, all seals: P-1439, P-1634, P-1700, P-2416, P-2696, P-2762 and P-2805. None are retired.

**3. Atlas Supplies, Portugal (C-2113):** three customers are called Atlas Supplies (Portugal, Britain and the Netherlands). Leaving out cancelled orders, the Portuguese one bought the most units of **Relief valve DN50 (P-1077): 60 units**. The rest are Piston seal 12mm, 55; Hydraulic hose 20m, 28; and Diaphragm pump 0.75kW, 5. The only status values in the store are open, shipped and cancelled, so the filter missed nothing.

**4. Atlas Supplies (Portugal), last order:** **O-11833, placed 2026-09-15, status open**, total 12,051.75. It's the latest of their 4 orders.

**5. Cellar pump:** **Submersible pump 0.75kW** (P-1747), described as a "Sump pump for draining flooded cellars; float switch included." It's made by **Inn Pumpen** (S-194, ships from Duisburg, Germany) and costs **189.00**.

**6. Brewery and dairy valve:** this is **Butterfly valve DN50** (P-1068), a "Sanitary butterfly valve for breweries and dairies". Units bought, leaving out cancelled orders:

**9. "Seawater pump":** the best match is **Seawater lift pump 1.5kW** (P-2639), a "Bronze pump for seawater", priced at 1,480.00. It scored more than twice as high as anything else. The runner-up was Multistage pump 4kW (P-1842), which handles seawater only with its bronze impeller option.

**10. Quillon Aerospace:** this can't be answered, because no customer of that name is in the store. I looked for an exact name, a retired record, names starting with "Quil", every name starting with "Q" (only the "Quarry …" customers) and a text search (only other "… Aerospace" customers). Please check the spelling or give me the customer's ID.
